description: Header file defining the CompositorNativeWindow11 class and RoHelper class for Windows UI Composition integration in ANGLE project, including methods for creating swap chains, handling Windows Runtime features, and managing native window properties.

classes.name: RoHelper
classes.description: Helper class for Windows Runtime operations such as string handling, factory activation, and dispatcher queue management.

classes.name: CompositorNativeWindow11
classes.description: Implementation of NativeWindow11 using Windows.UI.Composition APIs for Windows 10/11 native window handling with Direct3D 11.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the native window with optional alpha channel.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the native window and composition resources.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the client rectangle of the window.

methods.name: isIconic
methods.description: Checks if the window is minimized.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a Direct3D swap chain for rendering.

methods.name: commitChange
methods.description: Commits any changes to the composition surface.

methods.name: IsValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Static method to validate native window handle.

methods.name: IsSupportedWinRelease
methods.description: Static method to check Windows release support.

methods.name: IsSpriteVisual
methods.description: Static method to determine if the window is a sprite visual.
